muyu.lore.buddhas_apple: A lotus seal in gold. Grants the effects of an enchanted golden apple.
muyu.lore.divine_shard: Craft divine armor and tools, or repair worn divine gear at an anvil.
muyu.lore.destiny_bell: Ring for a random omen. The bell needs one minute to fall silent.
muyu.lore.godslayer: Buddha hopes you will never use it.
muyu.boundless: Highest rank attained. Merit continues to accumulate.
muyu.claim.wait: The lotus seat holds your gifts. Make room for automatic delivery, or use /muyu claim.
muyu.rehearse: Rehearsal armed. Your next valid knock starts a full ascension, including its reward and death.
muyu.passage: “Aspire to be born in that land.” — Amitabha Sutra
muyu.delivered: Delivered from the lotus seat  ·  %s is in your inventory.
muyu.line.arrival: “West of here, beyond a hundred thousand kotis of buddha lands, lies a world called Utmost Bliss.” — Amitabha Sutra
muyu.line.seen: “This mind makes the Buddha. This very mind is the Buddha.” — Contemplation Sutra
muyu.line.kind: “The heart of the buddhas is great compassion.” — Contemplation Sutra
muyu.line.complete: “Such are the virtues that adorn the Land of Utmost Bliss.” — Amitabha Sutra
muyu.line.blessing: “Cultivate merit and aspire to be born in that land.” — Sutra of Immeasurable Life
muyu.line.amitabha: “In that land is a buddha called Amitabha, who even now teaches the Dharma.” — Amitabha Sutra
muyu.line.receipt: “Dedicate your merit wholeheartedly and aspire to be born in that land.” — Sutra of Immeasurable Life
muyu.line.lotus_pool: “In its pools are lotus flowers as great as chariot wheels.” — Amitabha Sutra
muyu.line.radiance: “Each ray shines through the worlds of the ten directions, embracing all who remember the Buddha.” — Contemplation Sutra
muyu.line.recollection: “With a single purpose, keep the Buddha of Immeasurable Life in mind.” — Sutra of Immeasurable Life
muyu.line.lotus_birth: “One is born by transformation within a flower of seven treasures.” — Sutra of Immeasurable Life
muyu.line.mind_eye: “The mind’s eye opens and sees with perfect clarity.” — Contemplation Sutra
muyu.line.brow: “Contemplate the white tuft between his brows until you see it clearly.” — Contemplation Sutra
muyu.line.faith: “On hearing the profound Dharma, rejoice and trust in it, free of doubt.” — Sutra of Immeasurable Life
muyu.line.bliss: “The beings in that land know no suffering, only joy. Thus it is called Utmost Bliss.” — Amitabha Sutra
muyu.omen.halo: Buddha’s light  ·  A golden lotus rises around you.
muyu.omen.lightning: Trial of thunder  ·  A bolt has found you.
muyu.omen.echo: Echo of the fish  ·  The mallet answers %s times.
muyu.verse.diamond: “Let the mind arise without abiding anywhere.” — Diamond Sutra
muyu.verse.heart: “Form is emptiness, emptiness is form.” — Heart Sutra
muyu.verse.dhamma: “Refrain from evil, cultivate the good.” — Dhammapada
muyu.verse.appearances: “Whatever bears a mark is illusory.” — Diamond Sutra
muyu.verse.dream: “All conditioned things are like dreams, illusions, bubbles, and shadows.” — Diamond Sutra
muyu.verse.unborn: “Neither arising nor ceasing, neither stained nor pure, neither increasing nor diminishing.” — Heart Sutra
muyu.verse.nirvana: “Far from deluded dreams, one reaches nirvana.” — Heart Sutra
muyu.verse.few_wishes: “With few desires and no striving, body and mind are at ease.” — Sutra of the Eight Awakenings
muyu.verse.enough: “Remember contentment. Be at ease in poverty and keep to the path.” — Sutra of the Eight Awakenings
muyu.verse.no_contest: “Let go of winning and losing. Without contention, peace comes of itself.” — Dhammapada
muyu.verse.bare_earth: “One who is content rests at ease even on the bare ground.” — Sutra of the Last Teaching
muyu.verse.water: “A small stream, flowing without cease, can pierce stone.” — Sutra of the Last Teaching
muyu.verse.honesty: “An upright mind is a place of awakening, for it holds no deceit.” — Vimalakirti Sutra
muyu.verse.pure_land: “As the mind grows pure, so does the buddha land.” — Vimalakirti Sutra
muyu.verse.kindness: “Loving-kindness is a place of awakening, for it regards all beings equally.” — Vimalakirti Sutra
